boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Spelman and AUC spaces for studying, research, art, and campus programs, each supported by a direct College source.

cards.title: Robert W. Woodruff AUC Library
cards.subtitle: Atlanta University Center library
cards.notes: Use the library as a research base, then ask staff about collections and services supporting the four AUC institutions.
cards.short_summary: A shared AUC library and research hub.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman identifies the Robert W. Woodruff AUC Library as the intellectual and information hub of the Atlanta University Center and says it supports four AUC institutions.
cards.access_notes: Library hours are listed on the College page; confirm access requirements before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Beverly Daniel Tatum Suites, First Floor Study Room
cards.title: Beverly Daniel Tatum Suites Study Room
cards.subtitle: First floor, Beverly Daniel Tatum Suites
cards.notes: Bring your course materials to the first-floor study room when you need a designated on-campus place to focus.
cards.short_summary: A designated study room in the Suites.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman lists the Beverly Daniel Tatum Suites First Floor Study Room among campus study locations where registered students have 24-hour access, except as noted.
cards.access_notes: Listed for registered students’ 24-hour access except where noted; verify any building-access restrictions.

cards.title: Laura Spelman Hall Lower Level
cards.subtitle: Lower level, Laura Spelman Hall
cards.notes: Head to the lower level with a reading list or laptop for a campus study location identified by the College.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman lists the lower level of Laura Spelman Hall among campus locations where registered students have 24-hour study access, except as noted.
cards.access_notes: Listed for registered students’ 24-hour access except where noted; verify any building-access restrictions.

cards.title: Science Center Computer Lab 230
cards.subtitle: Room 230, Albro-Falconer-Manley Science Center
cards.notes: Plan a computer-based work session in Lab 230, a named campus study location on Spelman’s library information page.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman lists Albro-Falconer-Manley Science Center Computer Lab 230 among campus locations where registered students have 24-hour study access, except as noted.
cards.access_notes: Listed for registered students’ 24-hour access except where noted; verify lab and building-access restrictions.

cards.title: Wellness Center Throughway
cards.subtitle: Wellness Center at Read Hall
cards.notes: Use the throughway as a named on-campus study stop when moving between classes, and keep the space clear for others.
cards.short_summary: A designated study location in the Wellness Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman lists the Wellness Center Throughway among campus locations where registered students have 24-hour study access, except as noted.
cards.access_notes: Listed for registered students’ 24-hour access except where noted; verify facility and building-access restrictions.

cards.title: Spelman College Archives
cards.subtitle: Room 200, Camille Olivia Hanks Cosby Academic Center
cards.notes: Request materials in advance and schedule a research visit to work directly with College records and special collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman College Archives is the repository for College records and special collections, located in Room 200 of the Camille Olivia Hanks Cosby Academic Center.
cards.access_notes: Researcher hours are Tuesday–Friday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; use the College’s materials request process before a visit.

cards.entity_name: Spelman College Museum of Fine Art, Cosby Gallery
cards.title: Spelman College Museum of Fine Art: Cosby Gallery
cards.subtitle: First floor, Camille Olivia Hanks Cosby Academic Center
cards.notes: Visit the Cosby Gallery to spend time with art by and about women of the African Diaspora; follow gallery guidelines.
cards.short_summary: A campus museum gallery for close-looking and reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Spelman College Museum of Fine Art says it inspires the College community and public through art by and about women of the African Diaspora; its Cosby Gallery is in the Cosby Academic Center.
cards.access_notes: The College says admission is free and the gallery is open Wednesday–Saturday, subject to campus breaks and posted hours.

cards.title: Bank of America Gallery
cards.subtitle: First floor, Mary Schmidt Campbell Center for Innovation & the Arts
cards.notes: Pair an exhibition visit with time in the Center’s creative environment, observing posted gallery rules and current exhibition details.
cards.short_summary: A museum gallery inside Spelman’s arts and innovation center.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman’s visitor page identifies the Bank of America Gallery on the first floor of the Mary Schmidt Campbell Center for Innovation & the Arts as a Museum of Fine Art location.
cards.access_notes: The College says museum admission is free; Wednesday–Friday hours and campus-break closures are posted on its visitor page.

cards.title: Arthur M. Blank Innovation Lab
cards.subtitle: Mary Schmidt Campbell Center for Innovation & the Arts
cards.notes: Look for current Innovation Lab programs and use the Center as a place to connect creative work with technology and collaboration.
cards.short_summary: A named innovation space in Spelman’s arts center.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman identifies the Arthur M. Blank Innovation Lab as part of the Mary Schmidt Campbell Center for Innovation & the Arts, a cross-disciplinary collaborative learning environment.
cards.source_title: Mary Schmidt Campbell Center for Innovation & the Arts
cards.access_notes: Check current program availability and building access with the Center before planning a visit.

cards.title: Sisters Chapel
cards.subtitle: Spelman College campus
cards.notes: Attend a scheduled worship service or campus program if it fits your interests, and check the College calendar before heading over.
cards.evidence_claim: Spelman describes Sisters Chapel as its religious and spiritual center and states that Sunday worship services during the academic year are open to all.
cards.access_notes: Sunday worship is listed at 1 p.m. during the academic year and is open to all; confirm current programming before visiting.
